title: v5.108.6 shipped: v5.108.6: lock retry cap, optimizer meta never pages, dead anomaly metrics removed
summary: v5.108.6: lock retry cap, optimizer meta never pages, dead anomaly metrics removed
why: Three overnight-built Tier-1 fixes sat on an integ branch through the v5.108.x arc; operator approved shipping. Retry cap: endless lock.lock/close_cover retries hid broken locks (46 commands in one day), so cap at 3 per episode with one notice and a 24h re-arm; kept separate from the v5.108.3 lockout regime path. META pages: 9/9 critical pages in 30d were the AI layer complaining about its own truncated input, often 1-2:30am, so suppress paging only, keep recording. Anomaly metrics: operator asked fix vs delete; delete chosen because entry_anomaly_score duplicates alert_trigger_frequency (whose real shape defect is carded) and egress pauses are too rare for a z-score; comfort_deviation_hours kept with a producer card, so HVAC stays partial. Verified: merged onto v5.108.5 clean; serial full-suite name-diff 18 vs 18 identical failures, +25 passes; 5 key files 259 passed in isolation.
implications: Shipped SECURITY-LOCK-SWEEP-RETRY-CAP-1, OPTIMIZER-META-NEVER-PAGES-1, ANOMALY-METRIC-DISPOSITION-1 at v5.108.6; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.6.md (Live criteria).
